WBPSC ICDS Supervisor Preparation Tips 2026

1. Prelims - General Knowledge

  • Focus on West Bengal Specific GK like State History, Geography, Culture and Current Affairs.
  • Cover National Current Affairs of the Last 6 Months.
  • Read Newspaper or Current Affairs for 15 to 20 Minutes Daily and try to Make Short Notes for Quick Revision.

2. Prelims - Arithmetic

  • Practice Basic Topics Daily: Percentage, Ratio, Average, Profit & Loss, Simple/Compound Interest and Time & Work.
  • Since the Paper Is Objective With a 60-Minute Time Limit for 100 Questions, Speed and Accuracy Both Matter - Practice With a Timer.
  • Solve 20-25 Questions Daily, Covering Mixed Topics From Previous Year Papers.

3. Prelims - Reasoning

  • Practice Series, Coding-Decoding, Analogy, Blood Relations, Direction Sense and Puzzles for Regular basis to Improves Speed.

4. Mains - Descriptive Paper

  • The Mains Paper Is 400 Marks With 90 Minutes Per Paper so Practice Writing Answers Within the Time Limit.
  • Read About ICDS Scheme, Women & Child Development Policies and Social Welfare Schemes of West Bengal because These Are Directly Related to the Post.
  • Practice Bengali Language Sections Regularly because Proficiency in Bengali Is Generally Required for the Supervisor Post.

5. Viva-Voce (Personality Test)

  • Ready to Answer Questions on the ICDS Scheme, Your Educational Background and Why You Want This Role.
  • Stay Updated on Current Affairs Related to Women & Child Development.
  • Practice Mock Interviews to Build Confidence and Work on Clear Communication.
  • Attempt at Least One Full Mock Test Weekly toTrack Progress.
  • Keep Revising Previous Year Question Papers because Repeated Patterns Are Common in State-Level Exams.

  • Vocabulary: Learn 10 New Words Daily With Their Synonyms and Antonyms.
  • Comprehension: Read 2-3 Passages a Week and Solve Questions on Them, This Also Improves Reading speed.

3. Reasoning (A Speed Test)

  • Series, Coding-Decoding, Analogy, Blood Relations (These Are All Pattern Based, So the More You Practice the Faster You Will Solve Them).

Bihar Public Service Commission has invited online applications for BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026. Selection under TRE 4.0 works on a single-stage, merit-based model rather than multiple rounds of interviews. Since STET/CTET has already screened candidates for subject and teaching eligibility, BPSC's own test focuses on ranking rather than re-testing basic qualification.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT) - Objective Type Questions Covering General Studies, Language and Subject-Related Areas Depending on the Post
  • Document Verification for Candidates Who Clear the CBT Cutoff
  • Final Merit List Prepared Based on CBT Score, District and Category-Wise Preferences
